sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Laird Plastics is North America's largest independent plastic distributor and fabricator with 50+ distribution centers, specializing in signs & graphics materials, mechanical and engineering plastics, custom fabrication, and sustainable recycling solutions.

Industry: Plastics Distribution & Manufacturing · Size: 1000-4999 · Products: Acrylic sheets, Polycarbonate panels, HDPE, PEEK, PTFE, Ultem

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Laird Plastics scores 43 of 100 (tier C) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (16/25), company size (12/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (14% similar on specialty, films, chemical, signage); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (10% similar on films, performance, graphics, architectural); ORAFOL Europe (8% similar on films, plastics, graphics, materials). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
